player_prompt.intro:
Okei oyokaka {N} bima bingi ya kufwa ndenge mfulu.
Na kila ntangu, tanga [accept] okei osaka *oyo ya sasa*, tanga [continue] osaka oyokaka oyo ya nsuka.
Soko oyokaki ngasi osaka, oyokaki kufwa na oyo ya nsuka.
Oyandi (mbongo = 1) **kaka** soko bima oyokaki oyo ya juu koleka yankaka yonso.

outcome.summary: O ukimbiyi kiwulu {value} kuna kubanza {draw_num}/{N}. Kiwulu kizoluka yonso kale {best}. {result}
outcome.perfect: Yo vandaka nsola ya mbote kibeni!
outcome.not_max: Yo kele ve kiteso ya kuluta ngolo.
